Business inquiries

Start a conversation.
Share only what is needed.

The inquiry form is for business contact details and a short description of your settlement needs.

Information in an inquiry

The form asks for your name, work email, company, inquiry topic and message. If you attach a workflow from the planner, the selected direction, currencies, use case and indicative volume are included as business context.

Do not include bank account details, identity documents, credentials or sensitive customer information.

Delivery and response

Your inquiry is submitted through the website to the INRSettle team using the configured delivery service: Telegram or email. The team uses your work email to reply.

Submission is confirmed after the delivery service acknowledges the inquiry. If confirmation fails, the form retains your details so you can retry. The public workspace and planner are demonstrations; sending an inquiry does not create a payment or account.

Questions, corrections and deletion

Inquiries are handled as business correspondence. For questions about your inquiry, a correction or a deletion request, contact info@inrsettle.com.

This page covers the public business inquiry form. Data handling and contractual requirements for a production engagement are agreed separately.
